data.name: Gamit
data.gender_notes: Gamit is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Gamit is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Gam' meaning 'that which goes' and 'It' meaning 'knowledge'. The name signifies one who possesses knowledge and wisdom. It is a name often given to scholars and those who are considered wise in their communities. The name Gamit carries the meaning “Knowledgeable, Wise, Scholar” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Gamit usually hope their child will grow to embody knowledgeable, wise, scholar and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Gamit is deeply rooted in spirituality and represents the pursuit of knowledge and wisdom. It is a name that resonates with those who are seeking to deepen their understanding of the world around them and to gain insight into the mysteries of the universe.
data.etymology: Gamit belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Knowledgeable, Wise, Scholar.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gamit total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
